Differences Between Public & Private Sectors

e Most businesses constantly review their compensation practices; these reviews typically intensify when the financials of the core business erode.

e Considerations include compensation for comparable jobs, uniqueness of skill sets and education required for particular roles, productivity, hours worked, regional cost of living, job security, years of service, and financial health of the business unit.
